ABOUT JX7

I'm on the cutting edge of no-code tools that allow me to bring my creative visions to life. Though my methods may be unconventional, my dedication to the craft is unparalleled. I thrive on finding "unexpected solutions" and believe that with the right perspective.

MY APPROACH & STRATEGY

I take a pragmatic, design-first approach — rapid code & AI prototyping to validate ideas, then polish with hand-crafted HTML/Tailwind/JS when it matters. I prioritize clear UX, automation that saves time, and fast iteration through collaboration and curiosity. Always down to build smart, beautiful experiences together.
